summary.text: Chris May is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 65, which he has represented since November 2016, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia, which lists him as Christopher May, shows independent Sean Steele as his opponent in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Chris May was born and raised in Lawrence County, Indiana, graduated from Bedford North Lawrence High School and graduated from Vincennes University.
He worked as a sales engineer at Whitney Tool and became owner and operator of Hoosier Tech Properties, a business providing residential housing.

He has served on several boards, including the Lawrence County Solid Waste Management District, the Dunn Memorial Hospital board, the Lawrence County Economic Growth Council and the Lawrence County Redevelopment Commission.
May took office in the Indiana House on November 9, 2016.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the House Local Government Committee and as a member of the Financial Institutions and Insurance and Roads and Transportation committees.
